info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Prioritys-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Prioritization API enables users to efficiently access and list the various priority levels associated with support tickets. This endpoint provides critical insights into how tickets are categorized based on their urgency, helping support teams prioritize their response efforts effectively. Typically utilized by customer support representatives and IT service management applications, this API facilitates improved response times and enhances overall customer satisfaction. By integrating this endpoint into their systems, organizations can streamline their ticket management processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the priority levels for tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the different priority levels associated with tickets. Understanding these priority levels is crucial for effective ticket management and ensuring that urgent issues are addressed promptly.
